Name: Balanced Dynamic Quarry
Author: Theoddon
Description:
[heading]Quarry Improvements[/heading][list]
[*]Increased node spawn rates.
[*]Scales better with mining level.
[*]Has chance of coal, gems, and geodes nodes.
[*]Has low chance of cinder shard and radioactive nodes after reaching certain milestones.
[*]Cinder shard nodes are unlocked by gaining access to the volcano on Ginger Island.
[*]Radioactive nodes are unlocked after collecting 100 golden walnuts (to unlock Qi's Nut Room).
[*]Supports Hill Top and Four Corners farms.
[*]Supports skill prestige mods. If you reset your mining profession after unlocking Cinder shards or Radioactive ores, your quarry will not [i]completely[/i] reset.
[*]Supports Stardew Valley Expanded's map changes.
[/list][line]
[heading]Required Mods[/heading][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿
[/list][heading]My Other Mods[/heading][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul[/url][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21021]Bigger Silo Size[/url][/list]
